intent.rationale: Signed negative offsets compare incorrectly against unsigned limits, while nonnegative offsets compare correctly. The offset input has no range constraint.

labels.note: Signed a compared with unsigned b makes the comparison unsigned, so negative a compares as large.
Mixing signed a with unsigned b makes the comparison unsigned for negative a.

settlement.note: The unsigned operand makes the comparison unsigned; simulation confirms an incorrect mathematical result for a negative a and a correct result for positive a. Whether signedness changes the result depends on unconstrained input values, so convention 2 requires unknown.
